name: BQ_Hash_ID
description: Hash-based identifier used to uniquely identify the metadata record in BigQuery.

name: Project_EntityId
description: Synapse ID of the HTAN Project.

name: File_Size_Bytes
description: Size of the file in bytes.

name: File_MD5
description: MD5 checksum of the file contents.

name: HTAN_Center
description: Name of the participating HTAN Center.

name: Folder_EntityId
description: Synapse ID of the folder the entity resides in.

name: Component
description: The metadata component or assay type that the record describes (e.g., Diagnosis, Biospecimen, scRNALevel1, etc.).

name: Record_EntityId
description: Synapse ID of the record set containing the current record.

name: BQ_Hash_Record_ID
description: Hash-based identifier used to uniquely identify a record in a Synapse Record Set.
